name: Maldives
shortSummary: India has long been Maldives' first responder in crises, but the relationship cooled sharply after the 2023 election of President Mohamed Muizzu on an "India Out" platform, followed by a partial reset through 2024-25.
complexity: President Muizzu's 2023 campaign demanded the withdrawal of Indian military personnel stationed in the Maldives; relations were further strained by a 2024 social-media row involving Maldivian officials, though high-level visits since have sought to stabilise ties.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: India remains a first responder for medical evacuations and humanitarian needs.
Joint EEZ surveillance and hydrographic cooperation, though scaled back after 2023.

majorChallenges.title: "India Out" political sentiment
majorChallenges.description: Domestic Maldivian politics has periodically mobilised around reducing Indian military and strategic presence.

majorChallenges.title: Strategic competition with China
majorChallenges.description: Maldives has deepened ties with China on infrastructure financing, complicating India's traditional primacy.

recentDevelopments.title: Diplomatic reset following 2023-24 friction
recentDevelopments.description: Following tension over the "India Out" campaign and a 2024 social-media row, both governments worked through high-level visits to stabilise relations, including a Comprehensive Economic and Maritime Security Partnership.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Shows the relationship recovering from its lowest point in years, though the underlying strategic competition with China persists.

historicalEvents.title: Operation Cactus
historicalEvents.description: Indian armed forces intervene rapidly to foil a coup attempt against the Maldivian government, cementing India's role as regional security guarantor.

historicalEvents.title: Muizzu Election and "India Out" Campaign
historicalEvents.description: Mohamed Muizzu is elected president on a platform seeking the withdrawal of Indian military personnel, marking a diplomatic realignment toward China.

historicalEvents.title: Diplomatic Reset
historicalEvents.description: Following friction over remarks by Maldivian officials, both governments work to stabilise relations through high-level visits and economic assistance.

agreements.name: Comprehensive Economic and Maritime Security Partnership
agreements.description: Framework agreement reaffirming economic and maritime cooperation amid the broader diplomatic reset.
